title: Control Flow Practice 3
statement:
Module 2 (Control Flow) covers: if statements, for loops, while loops, break and continue, conditionals deep dive, nested loops. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 3: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (While Loops).
hints: Re-read the While Loops lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solution:
section .data
    msg db "Hello, World!", 10
section .text
    global _start
_start:
    mov eax, 4
    mov ebx, 1
    mov ecx, msg
    mov edx, 14
    int 0x80
    mov eax, 1
    xor ebx, ebx
    int 0x80
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
